directives.EXPLOIT: Refine conditions near the current best (small nutrient/oxygen step).
directives.BOREDOM_SNAP: Stop local refinement: move to an unvisited region or an under-visited hypothesis/assay cell from `suggest`.
directives.PARADIGM_BREAKOUT: Abandon the current hypothesis family; test a different limiting factor.
directives.CONVERGED: Frontier has stalled and every mechanism has been tried: re-run the current best (confirmation) instead of proposing new ideas.
